task.title: To attach a file in Salesforce to a new emails

prereq.p: The X-Author Outlook add-in must have been installed and you are connected.

step.cmd: In Outlook, click New E-mail and from the Message tab select Attach Salesforce File.

info.p: The default is to use Chatter files.
To change this to Attachments, click Show Criteria and select Attachments.

step.cmd: Enter a name or partial name for the object record which contains the file you want to attach and click
Click Select beside the object that contains the file and then click Open besides the file you want to attach.

result.p: The file is now attached to the draft email.

postreq.p: You can repeat the task to attach another file or send the email.
